import 'dart:async';

/// Abstract interface for AI Providers.
/// Supports switching between OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and local models.
abstract class AIGateway {
  String get providerName;

  /// Sends a prompt to the AI and returns the response.
  /// [context] can include historical messages or system instructions.
  Future<AIResponse> prompt(String input, {Map<String, dynamic>? context});

  /// Streams the AI response for real-time UI updates.
  Stream<String> streamPrompt(String input, {Map<String, dynamic>? context});
}

class AIResponse {
  final String text;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? rawData; // For structured outputs (JSON)
  final String provider;

  AIResponse({
    required this.text,
    this.rawData,
    required this.provider,
  });
}

/// A Mock Provider for testing and initial development.
class MockAIProvider implements AIGateway {
  @override
  String get providerName => 'MockProvider';

  @override
  Future<AIResponse> prompt(String input,
      {Map<String, dynamic>? context}) async {
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
    return AIResponse(
      text: "This is a mock response to: '$input'. AI Integration is pending.",
      provider: providerName,
    );
  }

  @override
  Stream<String> streamPrompt(String input,
      {Map<String, dynamic>? context}) async* {
    final words = "Mock streaming response for: $input".split(' ');
    for (var word in words) {
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
      yield "$word ";
    }
  }
}

FILE: lib\core\ai\providers\gemini_provider.dart

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:google_generative_ai/google_generative_ai.dart';
import 'package:zeno/core/ai/ai_gateway.dart';

class GeminiAIProvider implements AIGateway {
  final String _apiKey;
  late final GenerativeModel _model;

  GeminiAIProvider({required String apiKey}) : _apiKey = apiKey {
    _model = GenerativeModel(
      model: 'gemini-1.5-flash',
      apiKey: _apiKey,
    );
  }

  @override
  String get providerName => 'Google Gemini';

  @override
  Future<AIResponse> prompt(String input,
      {Map<String, dynamic>? context}) async {
    try {
      final content = [Content.text(input)];
      final response = await _model.generateContent(content);

      return AIResponse(
        text: response.text ?? 'No response from Gemini.',
        provider: providerName,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      return AIResponse(
        text: 'Error connecting to Gemini: $e',
        provider: providerName,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Stream<String> streamPrompt(String input,
      {Map<String, dynamic>? context}) async* {
    try {
      final content = [Content.text(input)];
      final responses = _model.generateContentStream(content);

      await for (final response in responses) {
        if (response.text != null) {
          yield response.text!;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      yield 'Error: $e';
    }
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:zeno/features/inventory/domain/models/category.dart';
import 'package:zeno/features/inventory/domain/models/brand.dart';
import 'package:zeno/features/inventory/domain/models/unit.dart';
import 'package:zeno/features/inventory/domain/models/warehouse.dart';
import 'package:zeno/features/inventory/domain/models/inventory_rule.dart';
import 'package:zeno/features/suppliers/domain/models/supplier.dart';

/// MasterDataPlatform (MDP) v1.2
/// Universal centralized platform for all ZENO BOS master data domains.
class MasterDataPlatform extends ChangeNotifier {
  static final MasterDataPlatform _instance = MasterDataPlatform._internal();
  factory MasterDataPlatform() => _instance;
  MasterDataPlatform._internal();

  // --- 1. INVENTORY DOMAIN ---
  final Map<String, Category> _categories = {};
  final Map<String, Brand> _brands = {};
  final Map<String, Unit> _units = {};
  final Map<String, Warehouse> _warehouses = {};
  final Map<String, InventoryRule> _inventoryRules = {};

  // --- 2. BUSINESS DOMAIN ---
  final List<String> branches = [
    'Main HQ',
    'North Retail',
    'South Distribution'
  ];
  final List<String> departments = [
    'Operations',
    'Sales',
    'Finance',
    'HR',
    'IT'
  ];

  // --- 3. CRM DOMAIN ---
  final List<String> customerGroups = [
    'Retail',
    'Wholesale',
    'VIP',
    'Government'
  ];

  // --- 4. PROCUREMENT DOMAIN ---
  final Map<String, Supplier> _suppliers = {};
  final List<String> supplierCategories = [
    'Manufacturer',
    'Wholesaler',
    'Distributor',
    'Importer',
    'Local Vendor'
  ];

  // --- INVENTORY ACCESSORS ---
  List<Category> get categories => _categories.values.toList();
  List<Brand> get brands => _brands.values.toList();
  List<Unit> get units => _units.values.toList();
  List<Warehouse> get warehouses => _warehouses.values.toList();
  List<InventoryRule> get inventoryRules => _inventoryRules.values.toList();

  // --- PROCUREMENT ACCESSORS ---
  List<Supplier> get suppliers => _suppliers.values.toList();

  // --- REGISTRATION ---
  void registerWarehouses(List<Warehouse> list) {
    for (var w in list) {
      _warehouses[w.id] = w;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void registerCategories(List<Category> list) {
    for (var c in list) {
      _categories[c.id] = c;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void registerInventoryRules(List<InventoryRule> list) {
    for (var r in list) {
      _inventoryRules[r.id] = r;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void registerSuppliers(List<Supplier> list) {
    for (var s in list) {
      _suppliers[s.id] = s;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  // --- RESOLVERS ---
  Warehouse? resolveWarehouse(String id) => _warehouses[id];
  Category? resolveCategory(String? id) => _categories[id];
  InventoryRule? resolveInventoryRule(String id) => _inventoryRules[id];
  Supplier? resolveSupplier(String id) => _suppliers[id];
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:zeno/core/widgets/zeno_kpi_hud.dart';
import 'package:zeno/core/widgets/zeno_table.dart';
import 'package:zeno/core/widgets/zeno_smart_inspector.dart';

/// ZenoWorkspaceManifest v1.0
/// The definitive infrastructure layer for ZENO BOS.
/// Every module defines its personality through this configuration manifest.
class ZenoWorkspaceManifest<T> {
  final String id;
  final String title;
  final String subtitle;
  final IconData icon;

  // COMPONENT PROVIDERS
  final List<Widget> Function(BuildContext) toolbarActions;
  final List<Widget> Function(BuildContext) filterActions;
  final List<ZenoKpiData> Function(BuildContext) kpiMetrics;
  final List<ZenoTableColumn<T>> Function(BuildContext) tableColumns;
  final List<ZenoInspectorTab> Function(BuildContext, T?) inspectorTabs;
  final Widget Function(BuildContext) commandVessel;

  // HUD INDICATORS (Status Bar)
  final List<Widget> Function(BuildContext) statusBarIndicators;

  // INTERACTION LOGIC
  final Function(BuildContext, T)? onRowTap;
  final Function(BuildContext, List<T>)? onSelectionChanged;

  const ZenoWorkspaceManifest({
    required this.id,
    required this.title,
    required this.subtitle,
    required this.icon,
    required this.toolbarActions,
    required this.filterActions,
    required this.kpiMetrics,
    required this.tableColumns,
    required this.inspectorTabs,
    required this.commandVessel,
    required this.statusBarIndicators,
    this.onRowTap,
    this.onSelectionChanged,
  });
}

import '../../features/administration/domain/models/organization.dart';
import '../../features/administration/domain/models/user_security.dart';
import '../../features/administration/domain/models/hardware.dart';

class GlobalContext {
  final Company? company;
  final Branch? branch;
  final GlobalWarehouse? warehouse;
  final POSTerminal? terminal;
  final User? user;

  const GlobalContext({
    this.company,
    this.branch,
    this.warehouse,
    this.terminal,
    this.user,
  });

  GlobalContext copyWith({
    Company? company,
    Branch? branch,
    GlobalWarehouse? warehouse,
    POSTerminal? terminal,
    User? user,
  }) {
    return GlobalContext(
      company: company ?? this.company,
      branch: branch ?? this.branch,
      warehouse: warehouse ?? this.warehouse,
      terminal: terminal ?? this.terminal,
      user: user ?? this.user,
    );
  }

  bool get isFullyConfigured =>
      company != null && branch != null && user != null;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:zeno/core/models/zeno_window_models.dart';

class ZenoWindowController extends ChangeNotifier {
  static final ZenoWindowController _instance =
      ZenoWindowController._internal();
  factory ZenoWindowController() => _instance;
  ZenoWindowController._internal();

  final List<ZenoWindow> _windows = [];
  int _nextZIndex = 1;

  List<ZenoWindow> get windows => List.unmodifiable(_windows);
  List<ZenoWindow> get activeWindows =>
      _windows.where((w) => w.status != ZenoWindowStatus.closed).toList()
        ..sort((a, b) => a.zIndex.compareTo(b.zIndex));

  List<ZenoWindow> get minimizedWindows =>
      _windows.where((w) => w.status == ZenoWindowStatus.minimized).toList();

  bool get hasActiveWindows =>
      _windows.any((w) => w.status == ZenoWindowStatus.open);

  void openWindow({
    required String id,
    required String title,
    required Widget content,
    required IconData icon,
    Size size = const Size(880, 600),
    Offset? position,
    String? updateRoute, // New parameter to signal tab change
  }) {
    debugPrint("Opening Window: $id ($title)");

    // CALCULATE CENTER POSITION IF NULL
    Offset finalPosition = position ?? const Offset(100, 100);
    if (position == null) {
      try {
        final view = WidgetsBinding.instance.platformDispatcher.views.first;
        final screenSize = view.physicalSize / view.devicePixelRatio;

        // Define the visible boundaries (excluding Top/Bottom system bars)
        const double topBoundary = 48.0 + 48.0; // Command Bar + Nav Bar
        const double bottomBoundary = 28.0; // Status Bar

        final double usableHeight =
            screenSize.height - topBoundary - bottomBoundary;
        final double usableWidth = screenSize.width;

        // Auto-scale window if it exceeds screen dimensions
        Size finalSize = size;
        if (finalSize.height > usableHeight - 40) {
          finalSize = Size(finalSize.width, usableHeight - 40);
        }
        if (finalSize.width > usableWidth - 40) {
          finalSize = Size(usableWidth - 40, finalSize.height);
        }

        finalPosition = Offset(
          (usableWidth - finalSize.width) / 2,
          topBoundary + (usableHeight - finalSize.height) / 2,
        );

        // Final safety clamp: Ensure header is ALWAYS visible and below system bars
        if (finalPosition.dy < topBoundary) {
          finalPosition = Offset(finalPosition.dx, topBoundary + 20);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        finalPosition = const Offset(100, 150);
      }
    }

    final existingIndex = _windows.indexWhere((w) => w.id == id);
    if (existingIndex != -1) {
      debugPrint("Window $id already exists, focusing...");

      // If it's a tabbed window, we might need to refresh it with a new initial route
      if (updateRoute != null) {
        _windows[existingIndex] = _windows[existingIndex].copyWith(
          content:
              content, // Replace with new content instance carrying the new route
          zIndex: _nextZIndex++,
          status: ZenoWindowStatus.open,
        );
      } else {
        if (_windows[existingIndex].status == ZenoWindowStatus.minimized) {
          restoreWindow(id);
        } else {
          focusWindow(id);
        }
      }
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }

    final newWindow = ZenoWindow(
      id: id,
      title: title,
      content: content,
      icon: icon,
      size: size,
      position: finalPosition,
      zIndex: _nextZIndex++,
    );
    _windows.add(newWindow);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void focusWindow(String id) {
    final index = _windows.indexWhere((w) => w.id == id);
    if (index != -1 && _windows[index].zIndex < _nextZIndex - 1) {
      _windows[index] = _windows[index].copyWith(zIndex: _nextZIndex++);
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void minimizeWindow(String id) {
    final index = _windows.indexWhere((w) => w.id == id);
    if (index != -1) {
      _windows[index] =
          _windows[index].copyWith(status: ZenoWindowStatus.minimized);
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void restoreWindow(String id) {
    final index = _windows.indexWhere((w) => w.id == id);
    if (index != -1) {
      _windows[index] = _windows[index]
          .copyWith(status: ZenoWindowStatus.open, zIndex: _nextZIndex++);
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void toggleMaximize(String id) {
    final index = _windows.indexWhere((w) => w.id == id);
    if (index != -1) {
      _windows[index] =
          _windows[index].copyWith(isMaximized: !_windows[index].isMaximized);
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void closeWindow(String id) {
    _windows.removeWhere((w) => w.id == id);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void updatePosition(String id, Offset newPosition) {
    final index = _windows.indexWhere((w) => w.id == id);
    if (index != -1) {
      _windows[index] = _windows[index].copyWith(position: newPosition);
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void updateSize(String id, Size newSize) {
    final index = _windows.indexWhere((w) => w.id == id);
    if (index != -1) {
      _windows[index] = _windows[index].copyWith(size: newSize);
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void resizeWindow(
    String id, {
    required Offset delta,
    bool top = false,
    bool left = false,
    bool right = false,
    bool bottom = false,
    Size minSize = const Size(400, 300),
  }) {
    final index = _windows.indexWhere((w) => w.id == id);
    if (index == -1) return;

    final window = _windows[index];
    double newX = window.position.dx;
    double newY = window.position.dy;
    double newWidth = window.size.width;
    double newHeight = window.size.height;

    // Handle Horizontal
    if (left) {
      final potentialWidth = window.size.width - delta.dx;
      if (potentialWidth >= minSize.width) {
        newX = window.position.dx + delta.dx;
        newWidth = potentialWidth;
      }
    } else if (right) {
      newWidth =
          (window.size.width + delta.dx).clamp(minSize.width, double.infinity);
    }

    // Handle Vertical
    if (top) {
      final potentialHeight = window.size.height - delta.dy;
      if (potentialHeight >= minSize.height) {
        newY = window.position.dy + delta.dy;
        newHeight = potentialHeight;
      }
    } else if (bottom) {
      newHeight = (window.size.height + delta.dy)
          .clamp(minSize.height, double.infinity);
    }

    _windows[index] = window.copyWith(
      position: Offset(newX, newY),
      size: Size(newWidth, newHeight),
      isDragging: true, // Reuse isDragging to disable animation during resize
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setDragging(String id, bool dragging) {
    final index = _windows.indexWhere((w) => w.id == id);
    if (index != -1) {
      _windows[index] = _windows[index].copyWith(isDragging: dragging);
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }
}

import 'database_service.dart';
import 'package:isar/isar.dart';
import '../services/global_context_manager.dart';
import '../di/service_locator.dart';

abstract class BaseRepository<T> {
  final DatabaseService db;
  final GlobalContextManager contextManager = sl<GlobalContextManager>();

  BaseRepository(this.db);

  IsarCollection<T> get collection => db.isar.collection<T>();

  /// Basic Pagination & Filtering Placeholder
  Future<List<T>> getPaged({int offset = 0, int limit = 50}) async {
    return await collection.where().offset(offset).limit(limit).findAll();
  }

  Future<T?> getById(Id id) async {
    return await collection.get(id);
  }

  /// Transactional Batch Insert
  Future<void> bulkSave(List<T> items) async {
    await db.isar.writeTxn(() async {
      await collection.putAll(items);
    });
  }

  Future<void> save(T item) async {
    await db.isar.writeTxn(() async {
      await collection.put(item);
    });
  }

  Future<void> delete(Id id) async {
    await db.isar.writeTxn(() async {
      await collection.delete(id);
    });
  }
}

int _companyCollectionEstimateSize(
  CompanyCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.address.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.currency.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.gst.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.pan.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.taxId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.timezone.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _companyCollectionSerialize(
  CompanyCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.address);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.currency);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.gst);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[3], object.isDefault);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.pan);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.taxId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.timezone);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.uuid);
}

CompanyCollection _companyCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = CompanyCollection();
  object.address = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.currency = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.gst = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isDefault = reader.readBool(offsets[3]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.pan = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  object.taxId = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.timezone = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  return object;
}

P _companyCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,

  switch (propertyId) {

    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }

    return deleteByIndex(r'uuid', [uuid]);

    return deleteByIndexSync(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return getAllByIndex(r'uuid', values);
  }

    return getAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', values);

    return deleteAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', values);
  }

extension CompanyCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<CompanyCollection, CompanyCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<CompanyCollection, CompanyCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CompanyCollection, CompanyCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CompanyCollection, CompanyCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CompanyCollection, CompanyCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CompanyCollection, CompanyCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idBetween(

    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CompanyCollection, CompanyCollection, QAfterWhereClause>

      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CompanyCollection, CompanyCollection, QAfterWhereClause>

        return query

              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],

              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(

              upper: [uuid],

int _branchCollectionEstimateSize(
  BranchCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.address.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.code.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.companyId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.phone.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _branchCollectionSerialize(
  BranchCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.address);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.code);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.companyId);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[3], object.isActive);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.phone);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.uuid);
}

BranchCollection _branchCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = BranchCollection();
  object.address = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.code = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.companyId = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isActive = reader.readBool(offsets[3]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.phone = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  return object;
}

P _branchCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });

int _userCollectionEstimateSize(
  UserCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final list = object.branchPermissions;
    if (list != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + list.length * 3;
      {
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
          final value = list[i];
          bytesCount += value.length * 3;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.displayName.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.email.length * 3;
  {
    final list = object.roleIds;
    if (list != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + list.length * 3;
      {
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
          final value = list[i];
          bytesCount += value.length * 3;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  object.id = id;

  IsarReader reader,

    case 1:

      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readStringList(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }

int _roleCollectionEstimateSize(
  RoleCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.permissionMatrixJson.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _roleCollectionSerialize(
  RoleCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.description);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[1], object.isSystemRole);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.permissionMatrixJson);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.uuid);
}

RoleCollection _roleCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = RoleCollection();
  object.description = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isSystemRole = reader.readBool(offsets[1]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.permissionMatrixJson = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  return object;
}

P _roleCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }

  QueryBuilder<RoleCollection, RoleCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(
      Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

int _auditLogCollectionEstimateSize(
  AuditLogCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.action.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.details.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.module.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.userId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _auditLogCollectionSerialize(
  AuditLogCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.action);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.details);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.module);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[3], object.timestamp);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.userId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.uuid);
}

AuditLogCollection _auditLogCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = AuditLogCollection();
  object.action = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.details = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.id = id;
  object.module = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.timestamp = reader.readDateTime(offsets[3]);
  object.userId = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  return object;
}

P _auditLogCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

    return deleteByIndexSync(r'uuid', [uuid]);

extension AuditLogCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<AuditLogCollection, AuditLogCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<AuditLogCollection, AuditLogCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<AuditLogCollection, AuditLogCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<AuditLogCollection, AuditLogCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {

      );
    });

  QueryBuilder<AuditLogCollection, AuditLogCollection, QAfterWhereClause>

      );
    });

int _securityLogCollectionEstimateSize(
  SecurityLogCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.eventType.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.ipAddress.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.severity.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.userId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _securityLogCollectionSerialize(
  SecurityLogCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,

) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.eventType);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.ipAddress);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.severity);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[3], object.timestamp);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.userId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.uuid);
}

  object.timestamp = reader.readDateTime(offsets[3]);

      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SecurityLogCollection, SecurityLogCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SecurityLogCollection, SecurityLogCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SecurityLogCollection, SecurityLogCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SecurityLogCollection, SecurityLogCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SecurityLogCollection, SecurityLogCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

import 'package:isar/isar.dart';

part 'ai_collections.g.dart';

@collection
class AIModelCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index(caseSensitive: false)
  late String name;

  late String providerId;
  late String type; // chat, vision, etc.
  bool isEnabled = true;

  late String capabilitiesJson; // Store as JSON string
}

@collection
class AISessionCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String userId;

  late String title;
  late DateTime startTime;
  DateTime? lastMessageTime;

  late String messagesJson; // List of messages as JSON

  @Index()
  String? moduleContext; // 'sales', 'finance', etc.
}

@collection
class AIUsageCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index()
  late String modelId;

  @Index()
  late DateTime timestamp;

  late int promptTokens;
  late int completionTokens;
  late int totalTokens;

  late double estimatedCost;
  late String userId;
}

@collection
class AIAutomationCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index(caseSensitive: false)
  late String name;

  late String description;
  late String trigger; // schedule, event, manual
  late String actionJson;
  late String status; // active, paused, etc.
}

int _aISessionCollectionEstimateSize(
  AISessionCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.messagesJson.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.moduleContext;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.title.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.userId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

}

int _aIUsageCollectionEstimateSize(
  AIUsageCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.modelId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.userId.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _aIUsageCollectionSerialize(
  AIUsageCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeLong(offsets[0], object.completionTokens);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[1], object.estimatedCost);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.modelId);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[3], object.promptTokens);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[4], object.timestamp);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[5], object.totalTokens);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.userId);
}

AIUsageCollection _aIUsageCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = AIUsageCollection();
  object.completionTokens = reader.readLong(offsets[0]);
  object.estimatedCost = reader.readDouble(offsets[1]);
  object.id = id;
  object.modelId = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.promptTokens = reader.readLong(offsets[3]);
  object.timestamp = reader.readDateTime(offsets[4]);
  object.totalTokens = reader.readLong(offsets[5]);
  object.userId = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  return object;
}

int _aIAutomationCollectionEstimateSize(
  AIAutomationCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.actionJson.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.trigger.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

extension AIAutomationCollectionQueryWhere on QueryBuilder<
    AIAutomationCollection, AIAutomationCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<AIAutomationCollection, AIAutomationCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<AIAutomationCollection, AIAutomationCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<AIAutomationCollection, AIAutomationCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<AIAutomationCollection, AIAutomationCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],

class CustomerCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

      ],
    )
  },
  links: {},
  embeddedSchemas: {
    r'CustomerAddressEmbedded': CustomerAddressEmbeddedSchema,
    r'CustomerContactEmbedded': CustomerContactEmbeddedSchema
  },
  getId: _customerCollectionGetId,
  getLinks: _customerCollectionGetLinks,

int _customerCollectionEstimateSize(
  CustomerCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final list = object.addresses;
    if (list != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + list.length * 3;
      {
        final offsets = allOffsets[CustomerAddressEmbedded]!;
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
          final value = list[i];
          bytesCount += CustomerAddressEmbeddedSchema.estimateSize(
              value, offsets, allOffsets);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.aiProfileJson;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.branchId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.categoryId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.companyId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.companyName;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final list = object.contacts;
    if (list != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + list.length * 3;
      {
        final offsets = allOffsets[CustomerContactEmbedded]!;
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
          final value = list[i];
          bytesCount += CustomerContactEmbeddedSchema.estimateSize(
              value, offsets, allOffsets);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.customerCode.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.email.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.groupIds.length * 3;
  {
    for (var i = 0; i < object.groupIds.length; i++) {
      final value = object.groupIds[i];
      bytesCount += value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.phone.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.salesRepId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.segmentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.tags.length * 3;
  {
    for (var i = 0; i < object.tags.length; i++) {
      final value = object.tags[i];
      bytesCount += value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.taxId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.territoryId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.tier.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.whatsapp;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  return bytesCount;
}

  writer.writeObjectList<CustomerContactEmbedded>(

  writer.writeDouble(offsets[8], object.creditLimit);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.customerCode);
  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.email);
  writer.writeStringList(offsets[11], object.groupIds);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[12], object.isCreditBlocked);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[13], object.isDeleted);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[14], object.lastPurchaseAt);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[15], object.lifetimeSpent);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[16], object.loyaltyPoints);
  writer.writeString(offsets[17], object.name);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[18], object.outstandingBalance);
  writer.writeString(offsets[19], object.phone);
  writer.writeString(offsets[20], object.salesRepId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[21], object.segmentId);
  writer.writeStringList(offsets[22], object.tags);
  writer.writeString(offsets[23], object.taxId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[24], object.territoryId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[25], object.tier);
  writer.writeString(offsets[26], object.type);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[27], object.updatedAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[28], object.uuid);
  writer.writeString(offsets[29], object.whatsapp);
}

CustomerCollection _customerCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = CustomerCollection();
  object.addresses = reader.readObjectList<CustomerAddressEmbedded>(
    offsets[0],
    CustomerAddressEmbeddedSchema.deserialize,
    allOffsets,
    CustomerAddressEmbedded(),
  );
  object.aiProfileJson = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.branchId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.categoryId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[3]);
  object.companyId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[4]);
  object.companyName = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.contacts = reader.readObjectList<CustomerContactEmbedded>(
    offsets[6],
    CustomerContactEmbeddedSchema.deserialize,
    allOffsets,
    CustomerContactEmbedded(),
  );
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[7]);
  object.creditLimit = reader.readDouble(offsets[8]);
  object.customerCode = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  object.email = reader.readString(offsets[10]);
  object.groupIds = reader.readStringList(offsets[11]) ?? [];
  object.id = id;
  object.isCreditBlocked = reader.readBool(offsets[12]);
  object.isDeleted = reader.readBool(offsets[13]);
  object.lastPurchaseAt = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[14]);
  object.lifetimeSpent = reader.readDouble(offsets[15]);
  object.loyaltyPoints = reader.readLong(offsets[16]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[17]);
  object.outstandingBalance = reader.readDouble(offsets[18]);
  object.phone = reader.readString(offsets[19]);
  object.salesRepId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[20]);
  object.segmentId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[21]);
  object.tags = reader.readStringList(offsets[22]) ?? [];
  object.taxId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[23]);
  object.territoryId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[24]);
  object.tier = reader.readString(offsets[25]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[26]);
  object.updatedAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[27]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[28]);
  object.whatsapp = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[29]);
  return object;
}

        lower: id,

      ));
    });

      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),

            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),

            .addWhereClause(

      } else {

              lower: [phone],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'phone',
              lower: [],
              upper: [phone],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }

  }

int _customerInteractionCollectionEstimateSize(
  CustomerInteractionCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.customerId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.details;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.summary.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.userId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

}

int _leadCollectionEstimateSize(
  LeadCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.aiInsightsJson;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.companyName;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.email.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.phone.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.representativeId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.source;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.territoryId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.aiInsightsJson);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.companyName);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[2], object.createdAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.email);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.phone);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.representativeId);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[7], object.score);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.source);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.territoryId);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[11], object.updatedAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.uuid);
}

LeadCollection _leadCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = LeadCollection();
  object.aiInsightsJson = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.companyName = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[2]);
  object.email = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.id = id;
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.phone = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  object.representativeId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[6]);
  object.score = reader.readDouble(offsets[7]);
  object.source = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  object.territoryId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[10]);
  object.updatedAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[11]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[12]);
  return object;
}

P _leadCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 12:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

extension LeadCollectionByIndex on IsarCollection<LeadCollection> {
  Future<LeadCollection?> getByUuid(String uuid) {
    return getByIndex(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  LeadCollection? getByUuidSync(String uuid) {
    return getByIndexSync(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  Future<bool> deleteByUuid(String uuid) {
    return deleteByIndex(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  bool deleteByUuidSync(String uuid) {
    return deleteByIndexSync(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  Future<List<LeadCollection?>> getAllByUuid(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return getAllByIndex(r'uuid', values);
  }

  List<LeadCollection?> getAllByUuidSync(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return getAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', values);
  }

  Future<int> deleteAllByUuid(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return deleteAllByIndex(r'uuid', values);
  }

  int deleteAllByUuidSync(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return deleteAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', values);
  }

  Future<Id> putByUuid(LeadCollection object) {
    return putByIndex(r'uuid', object);
  }

  Id putByUuidSync(LeadCollection object, {bool saveLinks = true}) {
    return putByIndexSync(r'uuid', object, saveLinks: saveLinks);
  }

  Future<List<Id>> putAllByUuid(List<LeadCollection> objects) {
    return putAllByIndex(r'uuid', objects);
  }

  List<Id> putAllByUuidSync(List<LeadCollection> objects,

  }
}

    on QueryBuilder<LeadCollection, LeadCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<LeadCollection, LeadCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idEqualTo(

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<LeadCollection, LeadCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(
      Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<LeadCollection, LeadCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idGreaterThan(
      Id id,

int _activityCollectionEstimateSize(
  ActivityCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.assignedToId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.customerId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.description;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.leadId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.opportunityId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.priority.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.salesOrderId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.ticketId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.title.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _activityCollectionSerialize(
  ActivityCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.assignedToId);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[1], object.completedAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.customerId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.description);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.leadId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.opportunityId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.priority);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[7], object.reminderAt);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[8], object.reminderEnabled);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.salesOrderId);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[10], object.scheduledAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.ticketId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[13], object.title);
  writer.writeString(offsets[14], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[15], object.uuid);
}

ActivityCollection _activityCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = ActivityCollection();
  object.assignedToId = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.completedAt = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.customerId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.description = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[3]);
  object.id = id;
  object.leadId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[4]);
  object.opportunityId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.priority = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.reminderAt = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[7]);
  object.reminderEnabled = reader.readBool(offsets[8]);
  object.salesOrderId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[9]);
  object.scheduledAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[10]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  object.ticketId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[12]);
  object.title = reader.readString(offsets[13]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[14]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[15]);
  return object;
}

P _activityCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 12:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 13:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 14:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 15:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }

int _campaignCollectionEstimateSize(
  CampaignCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.analyticsJson;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.description;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.targetSegments.length * 3;
  {
    for (var i = 0; i < object.targetSegments.length; i++) {
      final value = object.targetSegments[i];
      bytesCount += value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.title.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _campaignCollectionSerialize(
  CampaignCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[0], object.actualCost);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.analyticsJson);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[2], object.audienceCount);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[3], object.budget);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[4], object.conversionCount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.description);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[6], object.endDate);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[7], object.expectedRevenue);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[8], object.startDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.status);
  writer.writeStringList(offsets[10], object.targetSegments);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.title);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[13], object.uuid);
}

  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = CampaignCollection();
  object.actualCost = reader.readDouble(offsets[0]);
  object.analyticsJson = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.audienceCount = reader.readLong(offsets[2]);
  object.budget = reader.readDouble(offsets[3]);
  object.conversionCount = reader.readLong(offsets[4]);
  object.description = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.endDate = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[6]);
  object.expectedRevenue = reader.readDouble(offsets[7]);
  object.id = id;
  object.startDate = reader.readDateTime(offsets[8]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  object.targetSegments = reader.readStringList(offsets[10]) ?? [];
  object.title = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[12]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[13]);
  return object;
}

P _campaignCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readLong(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readLong(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readStringList(offset) ?? []) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 12:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 13:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

  return [];

    return deleteByIndexSync(r'uuid', [uuid]);

    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();

    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return deleteAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', values);
  }

  Future<Id> putByUuid(CampaignCollection object) {
    return putByIndex(r'uuid', object);

    return putByIndexSync(r'uuid', object, saveLinks: saveLinks);

    on QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QWhereClause> {

      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {

int _ticketCollectionEstimateSize(
  TicketCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.assignedToId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.category.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.customerId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.description;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.priority.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.resolutionNotes.length * 3;
  {
    for (var i = 0; i < object.resolutionNotes.length; i++) {
      final value = object.resolutionNotes[i];
      bytesCount += value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.subject.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.ticketNumber.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _ticketCollectionSerialize(
  TicketCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.assignedToId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.category);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[2], object.createdAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.customerId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.description);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[5], object.isSlaBreached);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.priority);
  writer.writeStringList(offsets[7], object.resolutionNotes);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[8], object.resolvedAt);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[9], object.slaDeadline);
  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.subject);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.ticketNumber);
  writer.writeString(offsets[13], object.uuid);
}

TicketCollection _ticketCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = TicketCollection();
  object.assignedToId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.category = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[2]);
  object.customerId = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.description = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[4]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isSlaBreached = reader.readBool(offsets[5]);
  object.priority = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.resolutionNotes = reader.readStringList(offsets[7]) ?? [];
  object.resolvedAt = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.slaDeadline = reader.readDateTime(offsets[9]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[10]);
  object.subject = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  object.ticketNumber = reader.readString(offsets[12]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[13]);
  return object;
}

P _ticketCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readStringList(offset) ?? []) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 12:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 13:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });

int _supplierCollectionEstimateSize(
  SupplierCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.address;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.category.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.city;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.currency.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.email.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.legalName;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.phone.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.supplierCode.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  SupplierCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.address);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[1], object.averageLeadTime);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.category);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.city);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[4], object.createdAt);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[5], object.creditLimit);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.currency);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.email);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[8], object.isDeleted);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[9], object.isPreferred);
  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.legalName);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.phone);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[13], object.ratingScore);
  writer.writeString(offsets[14], object.supplierCode);
  writer.writeString(offsets[15], object.type);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[16], object.updatedAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[17], object.uuid);
}

SupplierCollection _supplierCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = SupplierCollection();
  object.address = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.averageLeadTime = reader.readLong(offsets[1]);
  object.category = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.city = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[3]);
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[4]);
  object.creditLimit = reader.readDouble(offsets[5]);
  object.currency = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.email = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isDeleted = reader.readBool(offsets[8]);
  object.isPreferred = reader.readBool(offsets[9]);
  object.legalName = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[10]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  object.phone = reader.readString(offsets[12]);
  object.ratingScore = reader.readDouble(offsets[13]);
  object.supplierCode = reader.readString(offsets[14]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[15]);
  object.updatedAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[16]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[17]);
  return object;
}

extension SupplierCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query

import 'package:isar/isar.dart';

part 'finance_collections.g.dart';

@collection
class AccountCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index(unique: true)
  late String code;

  @Index(caseSensitive: false)
  late String name;

  @Index()
  late String category; // asset, liability, equity, income, expense

  @Index()
  late String type;

  String? parentId;
  late String currency;
  bool isActive = true;
  bool isSystemAccount = false;

  double currentBalance = 0.0;
}

@collection
class JournalEntryCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index(unique: true)
  late String referenceNumber;

  @Index()
  late DateTime date;

  late String description;

  @Index()
  late String status; // draft, posted, cancelled

  late String sourceModule;
  String? sourceDocumentId;

  List<JournalLineEmbedded>? lines;

  DateTime createdAt = DateTime.now();
}

@embedded
class JournalLineEmbedded {
  late String accountId;
  late double debit;
  late double credit;
  String? costCenterId;
  String? memo;
}

    on QueryBuilder<AccountCollection, AccountCollection, QSortBy> {
