int _journalEntryCollectionEstimateSize(
  JournalEntryCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  {
    final list = object.lines;
    if (list != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + list.length * 3;
      {
        final offsets = allOffsets[JournalLineEmbedded]!;
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
          final value = list[i];
          bytesCount += JournalLineEmbeddedSchema.estimateSize(
              value, offsets, allOffsets);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.referenceNumber.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.sourceDocumentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.sourceModule.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _journalEntryCollectionSerialize(
  JournalEntryCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[0], object.createdAt);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[1], object.date);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.description);
  writer.writeObjectList<JournalLineEmbedded>(
    offsets[3],
    allOffsets,
    JournalLineEmbeddedSchema.serialize,
    object.lines,
  );
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.referenceNumber);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.sourceDocumentId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.sourceModule);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.uuid);
}

JournalEntryCollection _journalEntryCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = JournalEntryCollection();
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[0]);
  object.date = reader.readDateTime(offsets[1]);
  object.description = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.id = id;
  object.lines = reader.readObjectList<JournalLineEmbedded>(
    offsets[3],
    JournalLineEmbeddedSchema.deserialize,
    allOffsets,
    JournalLineEmbedded(),
  );
  object.referenceNumber = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.sourceDocumentId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.sourceModule = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  return object;
}

P _journalEntryCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readObjectList<JournalLineEmbedded>(
        offset,
        JournalLineEmbeddedSchema.deserialize,
        allOffsets,
        JournalLineEmbedded(),
      )) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<JournalEntryCollection, JournalEntryCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),

int _bankAccountCollectionEstimateSize(
  BankAccountCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.accountNumber.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.bankName.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.branchName.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.currency.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.ifscCode;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.swiftCode;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  BankAccountCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,

  writer.writeDouble(offsets[1], object.availableBalance);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.bankName);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.branchName);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.currency);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[5], object.currentBalance);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.ifscCode);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[7], object.isActive);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.swiftCode);
  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.uuid);
}

BankAccountCollection _bankAccountCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = BankAccountCollection();
  object.accountNumber = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.availableBalance = reader.readDouble(offsets[1]);
  object.bankName = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.branchName = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.currency = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.currentBalance = reader.readDouble(offsets[5]);
  object.id = id;
  object.ifscCode = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[6]);
  object.isActive = reader.readBool(offsets[7]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  object.swiftCode = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[9]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[10]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  return object;
}

int _bankTransactionCollectionEstimateSize(
  BankTransactionCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.bankAccountId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.counterPartyName;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.referenceNumber;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.counterPartyName);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[3], object.date);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.description);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.referenceNumber);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.uuid);
}

  object.id = id;
  object.referenceNumber = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  return object;
}

int _expenseCollectionEstimateSize(
  ExpenseCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.category.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.claimId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.currency.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.departmentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.employeeId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.receiptUrl;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _expenseCollectionSerialize(
  ExpenseCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[0], object.amount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.category);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.claimId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.currency);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[4], object.date);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.departmentId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.description);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.employeeId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.receiptUrl);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.status);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[10], object.taxAmount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.uuid);
}

ExpenseCollection _expenseCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = ExpenseCollection();
  object.amount = reader.readDouble(offsets[0]);
  object.category = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.claimId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.currency = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.date = reader.readDateTime(offsets[4]);
  object.departmentId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.description = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.employeeId = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.id = id;
  object.receiptUrl = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  object.taxAmount = reader.readDouble(offsets[10]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  return object;
}

P _expenseCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

extension ExpenseClaimCollectionQueryWhereDistinct
    on QueryBuilder<ExpenseClaimCollection, ExpenseClaimCollection, QDistinct> {
  QueryBuilder<ExpenseClaimCollection, ExpenseClaimCollection, QDistinct>
      distinctByApprovedById({bool caseSensitive = true}) {

int _paymentCollectionEstimateSize(
  PaymentCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.method.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.payableId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _paymentCollectionSerialize(
  PaymentCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[0], object.amount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.method);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.payableId);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[3], object.paymentDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.uuid);
}

PaymentCollection _paymentCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = PaymentCollection();
  object.amount = reader.readDouble(offsets[0]);
  object.id = id;
  object.method = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.payableId = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.paymentDate = reader.readDateTime(offsets[3]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  return object;
}

P _paymentCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

  QueryBuilder<PaymentCollection, PaymentCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

int _budgetCollectionEstimateSize(
  BudgetCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.code.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.costCenterId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.departmentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.fiscalYearId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.ownerId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.projectId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _budgetCollectionSerialize(
  BudgetCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[0], object.allocatedAmount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.code);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.costCenterId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.departmentId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.fiscalYearId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.ownerId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.projectId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.status);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[9], object.utilizedAmount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.uuid);
}

BudgetCollection _budgetCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = BudgetCollection();
  object.allocatedAmount = reader.readDouble(offsets[0]);
  object.code = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.costCenterId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.departmentId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[3]);
  object.fiscalYearId = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.id = id;
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  object.ownerId = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.projectId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[7]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  object.utilizedAmount = reader.readDouble(offsets[9]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[10]);
  return object;
}

P _budgetCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

extension BudgetCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<BudgetCollection, BudgetCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<BudgetCollection, BudgetCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idEqualTo(
      Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BudgetCollection, BudgetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BudgetCollection, BudgetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BudgetCollection, BudgetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BudgetCollection, BudgetCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BudgetCollection, BudgetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BudgetCollection, BudgetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BudgetCollection, BudgetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      codeEqualTo(String code) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'code',
        value: [code],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BudgetCollection, BudgetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      codeNotEqualTo(String code) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'code',
              lower: [],
              upper: [code],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'code',
              lower: [code],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'code',
              lower: [code],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'code',
              lower: [],
              upper: [code],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

int _costCenterCollectionEstimateSize(
  CostCenterCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.code.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.managerId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.parentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

int _fixedAssetCollectionEstimateSize(
  FixedAssetCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.assetCode.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.categoryId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.custodianId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.depreciationMethod.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.groupId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.insurancePolicyNumber;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.locationId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  FixedAssetCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,

  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[2], object.capitalizationDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.categoryId);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[4], object.currentBookValue);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.custodianId);

  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.insurancePolicyNumber);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[10], object.isCapitalized);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.locationId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.name);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[13], object.purchaseValue);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[14], object.residualValue);

FixedAssetCollection _fixedAssetCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = FixedAssetCollection();
  object.acquisitionDate = reader.readDateTime(offsets[0]);
  object.assetCode = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.capitalizationDate = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.categoryId = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.currentBookValue = reader.readDouble(offsets[4]);
  object.custodianId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.depreciationMethod = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.groupId = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.id = id;
  object.insuranceExpiry = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.insurancePolicyNumber = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[9]);
  object.isCapitalized = reader.readBool(offsets[10]);
  object.locationId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[11]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[12]);
  object.purchaseValue = reader.readDouble(offsets[13]);
  object.residualValue = reader.readDouble(offsets[14]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[15]);
  object.usefulLifeMonths = reader.readLong(offsets[16]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[17]);
  object.warrantyExpiry = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[18]);
  return object;

extension FixedAssetCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<FixedAssetCollection, FixedAssetCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<FixedAssetCollection, FixedAssetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<FixedAssetCollection, FixedAssetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<FixedAssetCollection, FixedAssetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<FixedAssetCollection, FixedAssetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<FixedAssetCollection, FixedAssetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<FixedAssetCollection, FixedAssetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<FixedAssetCollection, FixedAssetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],

  AssetMaintenanceCollection object,

  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;

}

int _taxRuleCollectionEstimateSize(
  TaxRuleCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.category.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.code.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.country.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.state;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  version: '3.1.0+1',

int _taxReturnCollectionEstimateSize(
  TaxReturnCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.filingReference;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.periodId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _taxReturnCollectionSerialize(
  TaxReturnCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[0], object.filingDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.filingReference);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[2], object.inputTaxCredit);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.periodId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.status);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[5], object.totalTaxAmount);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[6], object.totalTaxableValue);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.uuid);
}

TaxReturnCollection _taxReturnCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = TaxReturnCollection();
  object.filingDate = reader.readDateTime(offsets[0]);
  object.filingReference = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.id = id;
  object.inputTaxCredit = reader.readDouble(offsets[2]);
  object.periodId = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.totalTaxAmount = reader.readDouble(offsets[5]);
  object.totalTaxableValue = reader.readDouble(offsets[6]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  return object;
}

P _taxReturnCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

      } else {

  ClosingTaskCollection object,

  var bytesCount = offsets.last;

  bytesCount += 3 + object.category.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.periodId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.title.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

      ));
    });

  QueryBuilder<FiscalPeriodCollection, FiscalPeriodCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<FiscalPeriodCollection, FiscalPeriodCollection,

    });
  }

      QAfterWhereClause> idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<FiscalPeriodCollection, FiscalPeriodCollection,

    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,

  }) {

              includeUpper: false,

            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {

  JournalLineEmbedded object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,

  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.accountId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.costCenterId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;

      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  return bytesCount;
}

@collection
class RestaurantFloorCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String name;

  late int sortOrder;
  bool isActive = true;
}

@collection
class RestaurantTableCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String tableNumber;

  @Index()
  late String floorId;

  late String section;
  late int capacity;
  late int currentGuestCount;

  @Index()
  late String status; // empty, reserved, seated, ordered, billed, cleaning

  String? activeOrderId;
  
  late double posX;
  late double posY;
  late String shape; // round, square, rectangle
  
  bool isMergeable = true;
}

@collection
class KotCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String orderId;

  String? tableId;
  late String orderType; // dineIn, takeaway, delivery

  late List<KotItemEmbedded> items;

  @Index()
  late String station; // kitchen, bar, tandoor, etc

  @Index()
  late String status; // new, accepted, preparing, ready, served, cancelled

  late DateTime createdAt;
  late int priority; // 0: Normal, 1: High, 2: VIP
  String? notes;
}

@embedded
class KotItemEmbedded {
  late String productId;
  late String name;
  late double quantity;
  String? modifiers;
  String? notes;
}

  object.id = id;
}

extension RestaurantTableCollectionByIndex
    on IsarCollection<RestaurantTableCollection> {
  Future<RestaurantTableCollection?> getByUuid(String uuid) {
    return getByIndex(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  RestaurantTableCollection? getByUuidSync(String uuid) {
    return getByIndexSync(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  Future<bool> deleteByUuid(String uuid) {
    return deleteByIndex(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  bool deleteByUuidSync(String uuid) {
    return deleteByIndexSync(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  Future<List<RestaurantTableCollection?>> getAllByUuid(
      List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return getAllByIndex(r'uuid', values);
  }

  List<RestaurantTableCollection?> getAllByUuidSync(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return getAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', values);
  }

  Future<int> deleteAllByUuid(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return deleteAllByIndex(r'uuid', values);
  }

  int deleteAllByUuidSync(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return deleteAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', values);
  }

  Future<Id> putByUuid(RestaurantTableCollection object) {
    return putByIndex(r'uuid', object);
  }

  Id putByUuidSync(RestaurantTableCollection object, {bool saveLinks = true}) {
    return putByIndexSync(r'uuid', object, saveLinks: saveLinks);
  }

  Future<List<Id>> putAllByUuid(List<RestaurantTableCollection> objects) {
    return putAllByIndex(r'uuid', objects);
  }

  List<Id> putAllByUuidSync(List<RestaurantTableCollection> objects,
      {bool saveLinks = true}) {
    return putAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', objects, saveLinks: saveLinks);
  }
}

extension RestaurantTableCollectionQueryWhereSort on QueryBuilder<
    RestaurantTableCollection, RestaurantTableCollection, QWhere> {
  QueryBuilder<RestaurantTableCollection, RestaurantTableCollection,
      QAfterWhere> anyId() {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(const IdWhereClause.any());
    });
  }
}

extension RestaurantTableCollectionQueryWhere on QueryBuilder<
    RestaurantTableCollection, RestaurantTableCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<RestaurantTableCollection, RestaurantTableCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RestaurantTableCollection, RestaurantTableCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RestaurantTableCollection, RestaurantTableCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RestaurantTableCollection, RestaurantTableCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RestaurantTableCollection, RestaurantTableCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RestaurantTableCollection, RestaurantTableCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> uuidEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RestaurantTableCollection, RestaurantTableCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {

              includeUpper: false,

            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

int _kotCollectionEstimateSize(
  KotCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.items.length * 3;
  {
    final offsets = allOffsets[KotItemEmbedded]!;
    for (var i = 0; i < object.items.length; i++) {
      final value = object.items[i];
      bytesCount +=
          KotItemEmbeddedSchema.estimateSize(value, offsets, allOffsets);
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.notes;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.orderId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.orderType.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.station.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.tableId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _kotCollectionSerialize(
  KotCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[0], object.createdAt);
  writer.writeObjectList<KotItemEmbedded>(
    offsets[1],
    allOffsets,
    KotItemEmbeddedSchema.serialize,
    object.items,
  );
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.notes);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.orderId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.orderType);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[5], object.priority);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.station);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.tableId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.uuid);
}

KotCollection _kotCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = KotCollection();
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[0]);
  object.id = id;
  object.items = reader.readObjectList<KotItemEmbedded>(
        offsets[1],
        KotItemEmbeddedSchema.deserialize,
        allOffsets,
        KotItemEmbedded(),
      ) ??
      [];
  object.notes = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.orderId = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.orderType = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.priority = reader.readLong(offsets[5]);
  object.station = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.tableId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  return object;
}

P _kotCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readObjectList<KotItemEmbedded>(
            offset,
            KotItemEmbeddedSchema.deserialize,
            allOffsets,
            KotItemEmbedded(),
          ) ??
          []) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readLong(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

extension KotCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<KotCollection, KotCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<KotCollection, KotCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idEqualTo(
      Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<KotCollection, KotCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(
      Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<KotCollection, KotCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idGreaterThan(
      Id id,
      {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<KotCollection, KotCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idLessThan(
      Id id,
      {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<KotCollection, KotCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<KotCollection, KotCollection, QAfterWhereClause> uuidEqualTo(
      String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<KotCollection, KotCollection, QAfterWhereClause> uuidNotEqualTo(
      String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<KotCollection, KotCollection, QAfterWhereClause> orderIdEqualTo(
      String orderId) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'orderId',
        value: [orderId],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<KotCollection, KotCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      orderIdNotEqualTo(String orderId) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'orderId',
              lower: [],
              upper: [orderId],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'orderId',
              lower: [orderId],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'orderId',
              lower: [orderId],

            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'orderId',

              upper: [orderId],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }

              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {

            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'station',
              lower: [station],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'station',
              lower: [],
              upper: [station],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }

int _kotItemEmbeddedEstimateSize(
  KotItemEmbedded object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.modifiers;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.notes;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.productId.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _kotItemEmbeddedSerialize(
  KotItemEmbedded object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.modifiers);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.notes);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.productId);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[4], object.quantity);
}

KotItemEmbedded _kotItemEmbeddedDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = KotItemEmbedded();
  object.modifiers = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.notes = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.productId = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.quantity = reader.readDouble(offsets[4]);
  return object;
}

P _kotItemEmbeddedDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

import 'package:isar/isar.dart';

part 'fnb_reservation_collection.g.dart';

@collection
class FnbReservationCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String customerName;
  
  @Index()
  late String phone;

  @Index()
  late DateTime reservationDate;
  
  late DateTime startTime;
  late DateTime endTime;
  
  late int guestCount;
  
  String? tableId;
  String? section;

  @Index()
  late String status; // pending, confirmed, seated, completed, cancelled, no_show

  double? depositAmount;
  late String depositStatus; // unpaid, paid, refunded, forfeited

  String? notes;
  late String createdBy;
  late DateTime createdAt;
}

int _fnbReservationCollectionEstimateSize(
  FnbReservationCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.createdBy.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.customerName.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.depositStatus.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.notes;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.phone.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.section;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.tableId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _fnbReservationCollectionSerialize(
  FnbReservationCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[0], object.createdAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.createdBy);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.customerName);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[3], object.depositAmount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.depositStatus);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[5], object.endTime);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[6], object.guestCount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.notes);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.phone);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[9], object.reservationDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.section);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[11], object.startTime);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[13], object.tableId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[14], object.uuid);
}

FnbReservationCollection _fnbReservationCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = FnbReservationCollection();
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[0]);
  object.createdBy = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.customerName = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.depositAmount = reader.readDoubleOrNull(offsets[3]);
  object.depositStatus = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.endTime = reader.readDateTime(offsets[5]);
  object.guestCount = reader.readLong(offsets[6]);
  object.id = id;
  object.notes = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[7]);
  object.phone = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  object.reservationDate = reader.readDateTime(offsets[9]);
  object.section = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[10]);
  object.startTime = reader.readDateTime(offsets[11]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[12]);
  object.tableId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[13]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[14]);
  return object;
}

  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readDoubleOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readLong(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 12:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 13:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 14:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }

    case 169:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 170:
      return (reader.readDoubleOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 171:
      return (reader.readDoubleOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 172:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

  return object.id;
}

    ProductCollection object) {
  return [];
}

    IsarCollection<dynamic> col, Id id, ProductCollection object) {
  object.id = id;

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.endsWith(
        property: r'widthFit',
        value: value,
        caseSensitive: caseSensitive,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ProductCollection, ProductCollection, QAfterFilterCondition>
      widthFitContains(String value, {bool caseSensitive = true}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.contains(
        property: r'widthFit',
        value: value,
        caseSensitive: caseSensitive,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ProductCollection, ProductCollection, QAfterFilterCondition>
      widthFitMatches(String pattern, {bool caseSensitive = true}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.matches(
        property: r'widthFit',
        wildcard: pattern,
        caseSensitive: caseSensitive,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ProductCollection, ProductCollection, QAfterFilterCondition>
      widthFitIsEmpty() {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.equalTo(
        property: r'widthFit',
        value: '',
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ProductCollection, ProductCollection, QAfterFilterCondition>
      widthFitIsNotEmpty() {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.greaterThan(
        property: r'widthFit',
        value: '',
      ));
    });
  }
}

int _categoryCollectionEstimateSize(
  CategoryCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.parentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _categoryCollectionSerialize(
  CategoryCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,

) {
  writer.writeBool(offsets[0], object.isDeleted);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.parentId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.uuid);
}

CategoryCollection _categoryCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,

) {
  final object = CategoryCollection();
  object.id = id;
  object.isDeleted = reader.readBool(offsets[0]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.parentId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  return object;
}

      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CategoryCollection, CategoryCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CategoryCollection, CategoryCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {

      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CategoryCollection, CategoryCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CategoryCollection, CategoryCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CategoryCollection, CategoryCollection, QAfterWhereClause>

    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CategoryCollection, CategoryCollection, QAfterWhereClause>

              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(

int _brandCollectionEstimateSize(
  BrandCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _brandCollectionSerialize(
  BrandCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeBool(offsets[0], object.isDeleted);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.uuid);
}

BrandCollection _brandCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = BrandCollection();
  object.id = id;
  object.isDeleted = reader.readBool(offsets[0]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  return object;
}

P _brandCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BrandCollection, BrandCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {

int _warehouseCollectionEstimateSize(
  WarehouseCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.address.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.code.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _warehouseCollectionSerialize(
  WarehouseCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.address);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.code);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[2], object.isDeleted);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[3], object.isMain);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.uuid);
}

WarehouseCollection _warehouseCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = WarehouseCollection();
  object.address = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.code = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isDeleted = reader.readBool(offsets[2]);
  object.isMain = reader.readBool(offsets[3]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  return object;
}

P _warehouseCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

    return deleteByIndex(r'code', [code]);
  }

    return deleteByIndexSync(r'code', [code]);
  }

extension WarehouseCollectionQueryWhereSort
    on QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QWhere> {
  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhere> anyId() {

extension WarehouseCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>

      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(

        value: [name],
      ));
    });
  }

              lower: [],
              upper: [name],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'name',
              lower: [name],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'name',
              lower: [name],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'name',
              lower: [],
              upper: [name],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }

int _stockItemCollectionEstimateSize(
  StockItemCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.productId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.warehouseId.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _stockItemCollectionSerialize(
  StockItemCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[0], object.lastUpdated);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.productId);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[2], object.quantity);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[3], object.reservedQuantity);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.warehouseId);
}

}

import 'package:isar/isar.dart';

part 'logistics_collections.g.dart';

@collection
class DeliveryOrderCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String salesOrderId;

  @Index()
  late String customerId;

  late String address;

  @Index()
  late String
      status; // pending, assigned, picked_up, out_for_delivery, delivered, failed, returned, cancelled

  DateTime? expectedTime;
  DateTime? pickedUpTime;
  DateTime? actualTime; // deliveredTime

  String? driverId;
  String? vehicleId;

  String? otp;
  String? signatureUrl;
  String? notes;
  double deliveryCharges = 0.0;
}

@collection
class VehicleCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index(unique: true)
  late String plateNumber;

  late String model;
  late String type; // bike, van, truck

  bool isActive = true;
}

@collection
class DriverCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index(caseSensitive: false)
  late String name;

  late String phone;
  late String licenseNumber;

  @Index()
  late String status; // on_duty, off_duty, on_break
}

  DeliveryOrderCollection object,

) {

  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.address);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.customerId);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[3], object.deliveryCharges);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.driverId);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[5], object.expectedTime);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.notes);

  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.signatureUrl);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.uuid);
  writer.writeString(offsets[13], object.vehicleId);
}

DeliveryOrderCollection _deliveryOrderCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = DeliveryOrderCollection();
  object.actualTime = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.address = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.customerId = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.deliveryCharges = reader.readDouble(offsets[3]);
  object.driverId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[4]);
  object.expectedTime = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.id = id;
  object.notes = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[6]);
  object.otp = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[7]);
  object.pickedUpTime = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.salesOrderId = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  object.signatureUrl = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[10]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[12]);
  object.vehicleId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[13]);
  return object;
}

P _deliveryOrderCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 12:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 13:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

int _vehicleCollectionEstimateSize(
  VehicleCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.model.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.plateNumber.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _vehicleCollectionSerialize(
  VehicleCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,

) {
  writer.writeBool(offsets[0], object.isActive);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.model);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.plateNumber);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.uuid);
}

  object.plateNumber = reader.readString(offsets[2]);

  return object;
}

      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }

int _driverCollectionEstimateSize(
  DriverCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.licenseNumber.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.phone.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _driverCollectionSerialize(
  DriverCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.licenseNumber);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.phone);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.uuid);
}

DriverCollection _driverCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = DriverCollection();
  object.id = id;
  object.licenseNumber = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.phone = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  return object;
}

P _driverCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<DriverCollection, DriverCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<DriverCollection, DriverCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
